topology.terminals: <list[str], length num_terminals> Named terminals served by the bus line.
topology.depot: <str> Identifier for the central depot where all vehicles are stored.
topology.num_terminals: <int> Number of terminals on the bus line.
topology.scheme_length: <int> Number of departure/arrival patterns per direction in the service scheme.

planning_horizon.start_minutes: <int> Start of the service day in minutes from midnight.
planning_horizon.end_minutes: <int> End of the service day in minutes from midnight.
planning_horizon.duration_minutes: <int> Total length of the service day in minutes.

directions.pattern_id: <str> Unique identifier for this service pattern.
directions.direction: <str> Whether this pattern runs outbound or inbound.
directions.start_terminal: <str> Terminal where trips of this pattern depart.
directions.end_terminal: <str> Terminal where trips of this pattern arrive.
directions.trip_duration_minutes: <int> Travel time in minutes for a single trip on this pattern.

time_windows.index: <int> Zero-based index identifying this time window within the planning horizon.
time_windows.start_minutes: <int> Start of this time window in minutes from midnight.
time_windows.end_minutes: <int> End of this time window in minutes from midnight.
time_windows.ideal_headway_seconds: <int> Target time separation in seconds between consecutive trips passing the main stop.
time_windows.min_headway_seconds: <int> Shortest allowable time separation in seconds between consecutive trips at the main stop.
time_windows.max_headway_seconds: <int> Longest allowable time separation in seconds between consecutive trips at the main stop.

{terminal}.time_window_index: <int> Index of the time window to which these stopping limits apply.
{terminal}.min_stopping_time_minutes: <int> Minimum dwell time in minutes a vehicle must wait at this terminal between consecutive trips.
{terminal}.max_stopping_time_minutes: <int> Maximum dwell time in minutes a vehicle may wait at this terminal between consecutive trips.

{terminal}.time_window_index: <int> Index of the time window to which these travel times apply.
{terminal}.pull_out_time_minutes: <int> Travel time in minutes from the depot to this terminal when starting service.
{terminal}.pull_in_time_minutes: <int> Travel time in minutes from this terminal back to the depot when ending service.

initial_trip_time_windows.{pattern_id}: <int> Time window index from which the first trip of the timetable must be selected for this pattern.

final_trip_time_windows.{pattern_id}: <int> Time window index from which the last trip of the timetable must be selected for this pattern.

penalty_function.type: <str> Form of the penalty applied to headway deviations.
penalty_function.description: <str> Formula describing how the penalty grows as actual headway deviates from the ideal.

objective_function.type: <str> Structure of the overall objective being minimized.
objective_function.description: <str> Formula combining vehicle scheduling costs and timetable quality costs.
objective_function.alpha: <float> Weight applied to vehicle scheduling costs relative to timetable quality costs.
objective_function.vs_cost_components: <list[str], length 3> Named components contributing to the vehicle scheduling cost.
objective_function.tt_cost_components: <list[str], length 1> Named components contributing to the timetable quality cost.

potential_trips.id: <int> Unique identifier for this candidate trip.
potential_trips.pattern_id: <str> Service pattern to which this trip belongs.
potential_trips.direction: <str> Whether this trip runs outbound or inbound.
potential_trips.departure_time_minutes: <int> Scheduled departure time from the start terminal in minutes from midnight.
potential_trips.arrival_time_minutes: <int> Scheduled arrival time at the end terminal in minutes from midnight.
potential_trips.main_stop_arrival_time_minutes: <int> Scheduled arrival time at the main headway-measurement stop in minutes from midnight.
potential_trips.time_window_index: <int> Index of the time window in which this trip falls.
